text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over 24 hours, with Ethereum declining faster than Bitcoin, suggesting some rotation away from altcoins toward the largest asset. The Fear & Greed index at 30 and worsening 20 points over the week points to growing uncertainty, while Bitcoin dominance holding steady above 59% indicates capital is consolidating rather than fleeing entirely. Volume at $142B remains substantial, so the selloff appears orderly rather than panicked.
